title: 11、送别（修）
content_zh:
口琴的旋律很动听。
而且那口琴声里好像夹杂着莫名的韵律，超越了寻常的音乐。
就像是昨夜，梦魇带给庆尘的感觉一样。
可是当所有囚犯都沉浸在美妙音乐里时，庆尘却根本无法压制自己内心里的惊讶与震撼。
因为他听过这首曲子……送别。
长亭外，古道边，芳草碧连天。
庆尘瞳孔渐渐收缩，这不是穿越后的世界吗，为何也会有送别这首歌。
他曾在见到机械文明的那一刻，以为这里与地球应该毫无关联。
可现在看来他错了，难道这里是地球的未来？
庆尘开始搜索脑海中的记忆，试图从他昨天记下的
可是结果让他再次失望了，那些心灵鸡汤和哲学并不能帮助到他。
口琴声停歇了，18号监狱里再次传来喧哗声。
某一刻，庆尘忽然觉得这座监狱就像是一个斗兽场。
一扇扇合金闸门背后关着的，是一头头代表着各种欲望的钢铁怪兽。
待到闸门直的朝楼下广场走去。
擅自行动没有招来天穹上的无人机，也没有机器警卫多看他一眼。
刚到餐厅外面，林小笑便笑眯眯的和他打起了招呼：“早上好呀……没睡好吗？”
此时庆尘顶着两个黑眼圈，他冷冷的看着林小笑，心说我能不能睡好，你心里不清楚吗？
有人说一个梦最长只有八分钟时间，相对整个生命来说极其短暂。
然而庆尘昨天结束梦魇以后数了一下自己的倒计时，那个梦魇竟是困了他两个多小时，他在梦魇里完全没有感觉到时间的流逝。

而且，从梦魇里脱困之后，他躺在床上又思索了很久的事情，直到半夜才沉沉睡去。
庆尘虽然有过目不忘的能力，但他本质上仍旧是个普通人，和林小笑这种特殊人群是不一样的，没办法熬了大半夜第二天还能生龙活虎。
李叔同看了一眼庆尘的面色说道：“一般人从梦魇里出来都会大伤元气，萎靡不振大半天时间，不过你比较特别，在梦魇里挣脱了小笑的控制拿起来了匕首，今天还能站着就已经很了不起了。”
庆尘在他对面坐下，竟是开门见山的问道：“怎么成为像他一样的人？”
李叔同笑了：“你倒是直截了当，不过你不能走他的路，反而更适合走我的路。”
这话一出，庆尘分明感觉到叶晚与林小笑的表情都出现了异样。
不知道为什么，他忽然感觉气氛严肃了一些，就连那只打盹的大猫都抬起头来看他。
他很想问问李叔同的路，到底是什么路。
可是从路广义对李叔同的态度来看，这位在外面可能是非常有名的人物，那就应该有很多人知道李叔同所指的路是什么。
而自己是一个穿越者，说点乱七八糟的碎碎念还可能没事，但问出很没常识的问题，就很致命了。
庆尘跳过疑惑，再次问道：“怎么才能走你的路？”
“你别误会了，”李叔同笑了。
当李叔同笑起来时，岁月在他眼角留下的痕迹才能让庆尘意识到，对方的年纪可能比自己想象的要大。
李叔同继续说道：“叶晚和林小笑是因为遇见我的时候有些晚了，所以没法走我的路。而我现在虽然欣赏你，但还不够。”
“明白了，”庆尘点头。
这才合乎情理。
他觉得，若是有人对自己一见如故然后倾囊相授，那对方可能很有问题。
自己面对的可能不是机遇，而是危险。
不过对于庆尘来说，能够接触到那神秘世界的边缘，就已经足够了。
那是他以前做过白日梦、地球上不曾有的东西。

现在自己距离那些，已经很近了。
“怎么样，今天还下棋吗？”李叔同看向庆尘：“我看你精神状态很不好，要不就休息一天吧。下棋这种事最讲究的就是棋逢对手，若是趁你状态不好赢了，那也没什么意思。”
随着囚犯们列队打饭、吃饭，餐厅里自由行走的囚犯越来越多了。
今天有些不同，很多囚犯一边吃一边关注着庆尘这边的动静。
甚至还有些人端着餐盘站起来吃，目光紧紧盯着棋盘。
其实在场囚犯能看懂象棋的人并不多，这本就是个脱离时代的娱乐活动了。
只不过李叔同喜欢，那大家就有关注的必要。
万一自己也有下棋天赋，被李叔同看重了呢？
当然，这只是一种畅想，更多人关注棋局，还是因为太闲了。
以前李叔同自己一个人看残局，没人敢盯着这边看，现在有庆尘对弈，气氛似乎轻松了许多，叶晚也不再拿目光刮人了。
一旁，连路广义也兴致勃勃的看着，他身后还跟着一群人宛如众星拱月似的。
路广义对此非常享受。
棋盘两侧，李叔同等着庆尘回复，而庆尘则站起身来平静道：“不用休息，投驱帝庭残局，车二平五、车五进七、炮二平八、车五平六、兵四进一。”
象棋本是你来我往的对弈，但庆尘这次干脆了当的说出了自己的每一步棋，像是已经料定了李叔同会配合自己走棋似的，直接将棋局推演到了终章。
庆尘的红弃車入局吸引黑将，与最终兵四进一相呼应，构成绝杀。
这是常人难以想到的精妙一手。
其他人或许不知道庆尘在说什么，但李叔同一定懂。
想要破投驱帝庭这一局，就只有这一条路可走！
李叔同抬头看了庆尘一眼，便将自己黑方老将倒扣在棋盘上：“我还以为你精神状态不太好，我赢了算趁人之危，没想到是我多虑了。”
人群里，路广义的小弟听到路广义喃喃道：“又赢了，这也太帅了吧。别管是在哪方面赢的，只要能赢李叔同这样的人物一次一辈子也都值了啊，我也想学象棋！”

那群刚刚被收拢的小弟有些不明白，路广义为何也会对象棋这种东西感兴趣。
要知道，路广义虽然武力值在18号监狱里出类拔萃，但文化水平绝对是垫底的那一拨。
这时，庆尘看着李叔同问道：“我能问你一个问题吗？”

content_en:
The melody of the harmonica is very beautiful.
Moreover, the sound of the harmonica seemed to be mixed with an inexplicable rhythm, which was beyond ordinary music.
Just like last night, the nightmare gave Qingchen the same feeling.
But when all the prisoners were immersed in the beautiful music, Qingchen couldn't suppress the surprise and shock in his heart.
Because he had heard this song... Farewell.
Outside the pavilion, beside the ancient road, the green grass reaches the sky.
Qingchen's pupils gradually shrank. Isn't this the world after time travel? Why is there also a farewell song?
The moment he saw mechanical civilization, he thought it had nothing to do with the earth.
But now it seems that he was wrong. Is this the future of the earth?
Qingchen began to search for the memories in his mind, trying to find out what he had written down yesterday.
But the result disappointed him again. Those chicken soups and philosophies could not help him.
The sound of the harmonica stopped, and there was noise again in Prison No. 18.
At a certain moment, Qingchen suddenly felt that this prison was like a colosseum.
What is closed behind the alloy gates are steel monsters representing various desires.
Wait until the gate and walk straight towards the square downstairs.
His unauthorized actions did not attract the drones in the sky, nor did the machine guards look at him twice.
As soon as he arrived outside the restaurant, Lin Xiaoxiao greeted him with a smile: "Good morning... didn't you sleep?"
At this time, Qingchen had two dark circles under his eyes. He looked at Lin Xiaoxiao coldly and said to himself, "Don't you know if I can sleep well?"
Some people say that a dream lasts only eight minutes at most, which is extremely short compared to the entire life.
However, Qingchen counted his countdown after finishing the nightmare yesterday. The nightmare actually trapped him for more than two hours. He didn't feel the passage of time at all in the nightmare.
Moreover, after escaping from the nightmare, he lay in bed and thought about the matter for a long time, and did not fall asleep until midnight.
Although Qingchen has the ability of photographic memory, he is still essentially an ordinary person. He is different from special people like Lin Xiaoxiao. There is no way he can stay up most of the night and still be alive the next day.
Li Shutong glanced at Qingchen's face and said: "Most people will be severely weakened when they come out of the nightmare, and they will be sluggish for most of the day, but you are special. You broke away from Xiaoxiao's control and picked up the dagger in the nightmare. It's already amazing that you are still standing today."
Qingchen sat down opposite him and asked straight to the point: "How do you become someone like him?"
Li Shutong smiled: "You are straightforward, but you can't follow his path. On the contrary, it is more suitable for you to follow my path."
As soon as these words came out, Qingchen clearly felt that the expressions of Ye Wan and Lin Xiaoxiao were strange.
For some reason, he suddenly felt that the atmosphere was a little more serious. Even the napping cat raised its head to look at him.
He really wanted to ask Li Shutong's path, what kind of path it was.
But judging from Lu Guangyi's attitude towards Li Shutong, this person may be a very famous figure outside, so many people should know what road Li Shutong is referring to.
And since I am a time traveler, it might be okay to talk some random thoughts, but it would be fatal to ask questions that lack common sense.
Qingchen skipped the doubts and asked again: "How can I follow your path?"
"Don't get me wrong," Li Shutong smiled.
When Li Shutong smiled, the traces of time left in the corners of his eyes made Qingchen realize that the other person might be older than he thought.
Li Shutong continued: "Ye Wan and Lin Xiaoxiao met me a little late, so they couldn't follow my path. Although I appreciate you now, it's not enough."
"I understand," Qingchen nodded.
This makes sense.
He felt that if someone fell in love with him at first sight and then poured everything into him, then the other person might have a problem.
What I face may not be opportunities, but dangers.
butFor Qingchen, being able to touch the edge of the mysterious world is enough.
It was something he had daydreamed about before, something that never existed on earth.
Now I am very close to those.
"How about it, do you still want to play chess today?" Li Shutong looked at Qingchen and said, "I see that your mental state is very bad. Why don't you take a day off? The most important thing about playing chess is to meet your opponent. If you win while you are in a bad state, it would be meaningless."
As the prisoners lined up to get food and eat, more and more prisoners were walking freely in the restaurant.
Something was different today. Many prisoners were paying attention to what was going on in Qingchen's side while eating.
Some people even stood up to eat with their plates in hand, their eyes fixed on the chessboard.
In fact, not many prisoners present can understand chess. This is an entertainment activity that is out of date.
But if Li Shutong likes it, then everyone needs to pay attention.
What if I also have a talent for playing chess and was valued by Li Shutong?
Of course, this is just a fantasy. More people pay attention to the chess game because they are too busy.
In the past, Li Shutong was watching the endgame by himself, and no one dared to stare. But now that Qingchen was playing against him, the atmosphere seemed much more relaxed, and Ye Wan no longer glared at anyone.
On the side, even Lu Guangyi was watching with interest, and a group of people followed behind him like stars over the moon.
Lu Guangyi enjoyed this very much.
On both sides of the chessboard, Li Shuping waited for Qingchen to reply, while Qingchen stood up and said calmly: "No need to rest, throw in the end game of the imperial court, two rooks draw five, five rooks advance seven, two cannons draw eight, five rooks draw six, and four pawns advance one."
Chess is originally a back-and-forth game, but this time Qingchen simply stated every move he made, as if he had already predicted that Li Shutong would cooperate with him, and directly deduced the chess game to the final chapter.
Qingchen's red rook entered the game to attract the black general, which echoed the final pawn's four advances and formed a decisive blow.
This is a subtle move that ordinary people cannot imagine.
Others may not know what Qingchen is talking about, but Li Shutong must understand.
If you want to break the game of Tou Expulsion Emperor Court, there is only one way to go!
Li Shutong raised his head and glanced at Qingchen, then put his black veteran player upside down on the chessboard: "I thought you were not in a good mental state. If I win, I will take advantage of you. I didn't expect that I was overly worried."
In the crowd, Lu Guangyi's younger brother heard Lu Guangyi murmur: "I won again. This is so cool. No matter where I win, as long as I can win against someone like Li Shutong, it will be worth it for a lifetime. I also want to learn chess!"
The group of young men who had just been gathered in did not understand why Lu Guangyi was interested in something like chess.
You know, although Lu Guangyi is outstanding in terms of force in Prison No. 18, his cultural level is definitely at the bottom.
At this time, Qingchen looked at Li Shutong and asked, "Can I ask you a question?"
